narrative: In 2020, GPT-3 showed that sheer scale turned a language model into a general-purpose, promptable tool, making scale the industry's organizing thesis. ChatGPT in late 2022 wrapped that capability in a chat box and reached a hundred million people, igniting a race that GPT-4 in 2023 escalated into multimodal, near-professional reasoning, while open models like LLaMA and Mistral built a parallel ecosystem. The next leap was thinking time, not size: OpenAI's o1 made inference-time reasoning a new scaling axis in 2024, and DeepSeek-R1 reproduced that frontier openly and cheaply in early 2025, collapsing the moat between labs and everyone else. Through 2025 the race turned into a crowded sprint of GPT-5, Gemini 3, Grok 4, and Claude's Opus 4 line, where gains grew incremental and agentic, measured in coding and tool-use skill. By mid-2026 the story is consolidation and diffusion: a few labs ship near-monthly releases, reasoning and agency are table stakes, and the open frontier sits close enough behind that capability, not access, is the scarce thing.

landmarks.name: GPT-3 (davinci, 175B)
landmarks.why: Proved scaling alone yields general-purpose, promptable language ability; set the scaling thesis of the era.

landmarks.name: ChatGPT (GPT-3.5)
landmarks.why: Put conversational AI in front of the public and triggered the fastest consumer-tech adoption ever.

landmarks.name: GPT-4
landmarks.why: First broadly multimodal frontier model with near-professional reasoning; set the bar rivals chased for years.

landmarks.name: Llama 2
landmarks.why: A usable open-weight model licensed for commercial use, anchoring open source against the closed labs.

landmarks.name: Mixtral 8x7B
landmarks.why: Brought sparse mixture-of-experts to open weights, making frontier-class quality cheap to run.

landmarks.name: GPT-4o
landmarks.why: Unified text, vision, and real-time voice in one native model, normalizing cheap omni-modal interaction.

landmarks.name: OpenAI o1-preview
landmarks.why: Opened inference-time reasoning, trading test-time compute for accuracy as a new scaling axis.

landmarks.name: DeepSeek-R1
landmarks.why: Matched the reasoning frontier as an open, low-cost model, shattering the closed-lab moat assumption.

landmarks.name: GPT-5
landmarks.why: Fused reasoning, multimodality, and agentic tool-use into one flagship; the pivot to integrated agentic systems.

landmarks.name: Google Gemini 3 Pro
landmarks.why: Cemented Google as a frontier co-leader and a mature, multi-lab, near-parity landscape into 2026.
